title: Blender tries to load libcudart.so on amd only machine and fails
body: Hi so i just installed arch on my amd machine with integrated gpu and everything seems to work except blender which tries to load some cuda (nvidia) stuff $ blender blender: error while loading shared libraries: libcudart.so.13: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory ofc cuda is optional (1/1) installing blender [############################] 100% Optional dependencies for blender cuda: Cycles renderer CUDA support intel-compute-runtime: Cycles renderer Intel OneAPI support intel-level-zero-raytracing-support: Cycles renderer Intel OneAPI Raytracing Support hip-runtime-amd: Cycles renderer AMD ROCm support hiprt: Ray tracing AMD ROCm support libdecor: wayland support [installed] version: blender 17:5.2.3-3 (newest) i reinstalled it few times and nothing, system is updated
